name: Companion
description: A companion that follows you, fights at your side, takes orders (follow, stay, attack) and wears gear you give it. F6 calls it and opens its order wheel. Every player in your game or on your server can have their own. Saved per world. Installed switched off.

settings.label: Order wheel key
settings.help: With no companion out it calls one. Then hold it to open the wheel (Follow me, Stay here, Attack, Gear, Dismiss); tap for a click wheel.

settings.label: Key: attack what you look at
Summon when a world loads
settings.help: Every player in the world gets one by itself (your guests and a server's players too).

settings.label: Companions out at once in the world
Respawn after (seconds)
settings.help: 0 = it stays dead until you call it again (the order wheel key).

settings.label: Faction
settings.help: 11 = PlayerAlly: never hits you, fights at full damage.

settings.label: Body (template GUID)
settings.help: The template the companion is spawned from (Enemy_Vukah_Melee).

settings.label: Stay marker (template GUID)
settings.help: What 'Stay here' places for it to guard. Empty = a barrel.

settings.label: Follow distance (m)
settings.help: 0 = the body's own. Changes every creature of that template, wild ones too.
